fact_check.claim: Fall 2025: 7,381 applicants, 864 admitted, 625 enrolled (CDS)
fact_check.note: brief §3.1 matches the page. The brief notes the CDS PDF was not re-extracted in its own check.

fact_check.claim: Transfer admit rate 11.7%
First-year fall 2025: 72,523 applied, 6,077 admitted, 3,827 enrolled, 8.4%
Transfer yield 72.3%; first-year yield 63.0%
Applicants per admit 8.5 (transfer) and 11.9 (first-year)
Transfer odds about 1.4 times first-year odds
Transfers 14.0% of the fall 2025 new class (625 of 4,452)
fact_check.note: Recomputed 625/(3,827+625) = 14.04%. The 'one in seven' caption agrees.

fact_check.claim: Housing office says transfers are 'almost 15%'
Fall 2024: 7,218 applied, 670 admitted, 9.3% (third-party, labeled as such)
Fall 2023: 6,581 applied, 834 admitted, 12.7%
Rate fell 3.4 points from 2023 to 2024; applicants grew 12.2% from 6,581 to 7,381; admits rose by 30
Old rates 18% and 15.7% overstate odds by a third to a half versus 11.7%

fact_check.note: brief §3.2. Each figure is labeled with its source kind on the page.

fact_check.claim: Fall 2026: 603 transfers with 3,681 first-years is 14.1% of the new class
Fall 2021 by college: CALS 243, ILR 116, A&S 102, Human Ecology 59, Dyson 54, Hotel 48, Engineering 37, AAP 15; total 674
Contract colleges took 472 of 674, or 70.0%
Fall 2021: 578 of 674 from four-year schools; 96 from community colleges (14.2%); 86 international (12.8%)
Cornell says about a quarter of transfers come from community colleges; no preference by school type
Chronicle 2024: about 100 community college students admitted a year
TC3 to CALS agreement of 2025 gives 'priority consideration', not admission
Admitted transfers 'generally' 3.3 or better; 'selective and highly competitive'
GPA table: CALS 3.0 (3.5 Biological Sciences) minimum; ILR 3.4 typical; Human Ecology 3.5 competitive; Engineering none stated
CALS bars more than four semesters at a four-year school; CALS transfers nearly one-third of students
ILR: about one-third of graduates transferred in
Engineering: junior entry only in first semester of junior standing; file missing math, physics and chemistry block not reviewed
Cornell takes two to four semesters done; most colleges cap transfer credit near 60; FAQ discourages transfer after junior year
fact_check.note: brief mentions 'two to four' and the 60-credit cap.

fact_check.claim: Eligibility: 12 semester hours of college credit after high school or full-time enrollment elsewhere; no bachelor's degree held
Denied Regular Decision first-year applicants may reapply as transfers
Need-blind for domestic applicants, need-aware for international ones
fact_check.note: The brief carries only 'need-blind'. The admissions page was fetched and states need-blind for U.S. students and need-aware for international applicants.

fact_check.claim: Cornell meets 100% of demonstrated need for those it admits
Decisions roll from late April through June; external transfer applications for fall only; $85 fee
fact_check.note: Fetched the page: 'from late April through June', 'for the fall semester only', $85 fee. All also in the brief.
